calculation.expression: (-rolling_sum_10(asset_log_return - equal_weight_cross_asset_log_return) / rolling_mean_20(asset_volatility_20)).shift(1), active only when cross_asset_dispersion_20 exceeds its trailing_120d median
calculation.description: Ranks assets by recent underperformance relative to the equal-weight benchmark, normalized by volatility, but activates only during elevated cross-asset dispersion. One-day lag prevents look-ahead bias.

validation.regime_notes: Positive in available regimes: 2024-2026 IC 0.17805 (82 dates), 2027-2029 IC 0.01862 (363 dates), 2030-2032 IC 0.03784 (290 dates). No qualifying observations were available in 2020-2023 under the activation condition; interpret small cross-section conservatively.
